title: Tremblant Snowlight Gondola Ride
subtitle: Mont-Tremblant · a night cable-car ride
design_notes: No music, no voices or breathing, no water.
Outside wind crossfades to a muffled copy when the cabin door closes.
Loops have different lengths (30/23/27 s) so they never repeat in step.
Pine wind grows in slowly over 40 s from the end of the town section, so it is already there when the pines are named.
Lift towers repeat as the cabin climbs, each quieter than the last and a different recording; nothing after 8:12.

ambient_bed.prompt: Gentle winter wind in a quiet snowy mountain village at night, soft snowfall, no voices, no music
Inside a closed ski gondola cabin, low steady hum of the moving cable, very soft and calm, no voices
Soft wind through a snowy pine forest at night, distant and calm

sfx_library.prompt: Slow soft footsteps crunching in fresh deep snow, unhurried, close
Ski gondola cabin door sliding shut with a soft muffled thud
A single distant church bell ringing once across a snowy mountain village at night, soft and far away
Ski gondola cabin rolling gently over a lift tower, soft low rumble and gentle creak, heard from inside
A clump of snow sliding off a pine branch, soft muffled whump
A single distant owl hooting softly in a snowy forest at night

segments.text: Tonight, we're in Tremblant... a little village at the foot of the mountain, deep in winter. It's late. The day is done... and the snow is falling, slow and soft.
The village looks like something from a storybook. Steep roofs in red, and blue, and yellow... each one wearing a thick white blanket of snow.
Narrow lanes wind between them, with little stone stairs, and wooden balconies, and shop signs hanging still in the cold air.
At the edge of the village stands a small white chapel, its steeple dusted with snow.
Old lamps glow soft and gold along the lanes... and the snow drifts down through their light... taking its time.
Little lights are strung through the bare trees, like stars that came down to rest. Every window is warm. Frost lace on the glass... a hint of woodsmoke... and something sweet, like maple.
The snow has softened every edge. Railings, benches, the little fountain in the square... all of it rounded, and white, and quiet.
Your boots press softly into the fresh snow. There's no hurry. The whole village feels hushed, and safe... as if it's been tucked in for the night.
Above it all, the mountain rises into the dark. The gondola cabins climb its side... quiet little lanterns, rising into the snow.
At the station, a cabin glides in, slow and patient. The door slides open... you step inside... and it closes softly behind you.
Inside, the wind is only a whisper now. It's warm, and still, and safe. Let yourself sink onto the bench.
Feel the warmth coming back into your hands... your fingers... all the way to their tips.
Let your shoulders drop. Let your back rest against the seat. Your legs grow heavy... and still.
The cabin sways, just a little... and begins to rise.
Below, the village slips slowly away. Snowy rooftops... glowing windows... the lamps along the lanes, like a string of warm beads.
The cabin rocks gently as it passes a tower... then settles, and glides on.

sfx.note: first roll in the gap after 'tower,'

segments.text: From up here, the village looks like a little glowing toy... the white chapel, the frozen pond, the rooftops tucked close together.
The lights grow small, and soft, and far away... until the village is only a warm glow in the snow below.
Now the pines close in. Tall and dark, their branches heavy with snow, so close you could almost touch them.
The cabin's soft light slides across the snowy branches as you pass... a silver glow, there, and gone.
Somewhere, a little snow slips from a branch... and falls with a soft hush into the deep white below.

sfx.note: slide under 'from a branch', settles in the gap

segments.text: Far across the slopes, the lights of a snow groomer move slowly... a tiny glow, crawling through the dark.
Deep in the forest, an owl calls... once... and the woods go quiet again.

sfx.note: hoot 2.5 s before the line, so it's heard, then named

segments.text: The cabin slows. The snow drifts past the glass... soft... and slow.
Higher... and quieter... and slower still.
Only the wind... and the quiet hum... carrying you up.
Snow... and stillness... and the gentle climb...

mix.note: no breathing cues in this wind-down, so the cabin ambience stays near full
